notes.title: State of Matter: Hotfix 1.1.1
notes.content:
An update to State of Matter has been released! The update will be applied automatically when you restart the game.
 General
 Added VFX to Plutinite chunks that come from dispensers
 Added a 2-second grace period from enemy attacks after falling into a pit
 Updated canister podiums to also flash yellow when a canister is docked
 Increased the physical size of ranged enemies by 33%
 Falling into a killzone too many times is now lethal
 Fixed an issue with “slipping” from slightly steep sloped surfaces [say that 10x fast]
 Fixed an issue where the cursor remained visible after returning from the Steam Overlay

 Levels 
 Updated The Surface
 Added some rocks to prevent a potential softlock
 Updated The Mines
 Fixed an issue with broken glass colliders in a certain puzzle room in The Shack


Please post feedback and bug reports within the Discussions area of the Community Hub or directly within our Discord.

notes.title: State of Matter: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
An update to State of Matter has been released! The update will be applied automatically when you restart the game.

General
 Added Plutinite Dispensers to The Plant and The Mines
 Dispensers regularly drop Plutinite chunks that cool down the Phasm SLG by 50%, double that of chunks dropped from enemies
 These are only placed in areas revolving around puzzles and/or platforming
 Updated knockback from fuel cell explosions to be double its current force
 Updated siphon targeting angle from 6 degrees to 8 degrees, making aim more forgiving
 Fixed “prop flying” siphon exploit that allowed various platforming sections to be skipped
 Fixed an issue where movement would feel slippery on certain moving objects
 Fixed an issue where gas clouds emitted from the Phasm SLG could fire through walls
 Fixed an issue where crouching automatically stops when running into certain walls when using controller
 Fixed an issue where fuel cell explosion VFX mismatched the true area of effect radius
 Fixed an issue where solid mode projectiles could attach to unintended props
 Fixed a softlock when falling off of a moving platform before it reaches its destination
UI
 Added two new settings to the Options Menu
 Max FPS - Max framerate can be: 30, 60, 120, 144, 240, or unlimited (default)
 VSync - VSync can now be disabled or enabled (default)
 Updated framerate to be automatically capped at 60 when in menus
 Improved all menus significantly
Levels
 Updated The Surface
 Added tutorial UI for siphoning Plutinite chunks to cool down the Phasm SLG
 Fixed enemies respawning unintentionally after reloading a checkpoint in A.L.I.C.E.’s Chambers after completing The Surface
 Fixed crouch tutorial trigger sizing
 Fixed an instance of a flickering wall texture in The Facility
 Removed the ability to see the correct puzzle sequence within the game files
 Updated The Descent
 Fixed being able to activate The Descent elevator without being physically on it
 Updated The Plant
 Added tutorial UI for the burst combat mechanic
 Updated The Mines
 Improved positioning of broken glass in a certain puzzle room in The Shack
 Fixed being able to quickly dash back through the doors following the cutscene at the top of The Shack
 Fixed a checkpoint after completing the top of The Shack to reset things properly
 Fixed an instance of a flickering wall texture in The Shack
 Removed all crates from the arena inside of The Shack
 Updated The Vault
 Updated duration between enemy wave spawns to be slightly longer
 Updated The Escape
 Removed a few enemy spawns to reduce density in smaller areas

We hope everyone who has played has enjoyed the game! Please post feedback and bug reports within the Discussions area of the Community Hub or directly within our Discord.
